scene.prompt: The Onon and Kherlen valleys: endless green steppe under a huge blue sky, white felt yurts with orange doors, herds of horses and sheep, a stone ovoo cairn with blue silk scarves on a hill

Karakorum on the Orkhon river: a mud wall around the imperial city, the Tumen Amgalan palace under green tiles, stone turtles, the silver tree fountain, mosques, a church and Buddhist temples among yurts

Khanbaliq (Dadu), capital of the Yuan: rammed-earth walls and gate towers, the white stupa of Miaoying temple, palace roofs of green and yellow tiles, the Jishuitan harbour of the Grand Canal, Mongol yurts inside the palace park
Sarai on the lower Volga (Akhtuba): a sprawling adobe city with a blue-tiled mosque, caravanserais and bazaars, the khan's golden tent, yurts and wagons on the edges, the wide river
Tabriz under the Ilkhans: brick and tile mosques and the Rab-e Rashidi quarter, the citadel of Ghazan, caravans of camels, Mongol tents on the summer pasture of Ujan beyond the city
